remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

add_definitions(
    -D_ATL_VER=_ATL_VER_80)

spec2def(atl80.dll atl80.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(atl80 regtypelib ../atl/atl_lib.idl)

# atl80.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/atl80-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(atl80_shims OBJECT ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/win32/atl/atl.c atl80.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/win32/atl/atl_ax.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/win32/atl/registrar.c)
target_link_libraries(atl80_shims PRIVATE uuid wine oldnames liboleaut32 libuser32 libole32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libadvapi32_vista libshlwapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(atl80_shims)
set(ATL80_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/atl80/atl_lib_t.o)
add_cargo_module(atl80 atl80-cargo atl80.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS atl80_shims atl80_t ${ATL80_REUSED} psdk uuid_sources)
